craft_notes: Sthāyin: bhakti-utsāha of opening vow — the vow performs (world-body + world-surpassing predicated together); FIRST PASSAGE of the work sets the house voice (paradox-as-program; owner verdict required). Abhinavagupta frame: praṇaya (love-address) toward consciousness as heart. Vow that performs: paradox predicated together (world-body + world-surpassing) before exposition — paradox IS the program (INF). Rejected: (a) expanding Parādi → killed by UNC (threefold scale, not expanded). (b) authorship dispute in song → killed: logged in prose, never sung. Read aloud: VEN-er-A-tion TO-śi-VA, WHOSE-ver-y-SELF IS-ev-ery-LEV-el … IT-WEARS the-WORLD as-ITS-bo-DY, YET-stands be-YOND the-WORLD, PULS-ing AS su-PREME-POW-er.

lines: Veneration to Śiva, whose very self is every level of reality.
Here begins the Entering into the Supreme, by glorious Kṣemarāja, noblest of the great Māheśvara masters.
And we bow to knowing itself — the heart of the supreme Lord: it wears the world as its body, yet stands beyond the world, pulsing as supreme power.

reads_against.argmap: What consciousness is venerated, and under which form? → Immanence and transcendence predicated together before any exposition; the paradox is the program.
c1_essence: The vow binds deity to doctrine in one compound and predicates contraries together — world-shaped yet world-surpassing consciousness, throbbing as supreme power.
